Name: daily luck for BurglarsRing
Author: suHuayun
Description:
现在窃贼戒指效果将受每日运气影响，窃贼戒指的触发将呈现一个正态分布，其均值和方差均与每日运气有关。
The effectiveness of the Burglars ring will now be influenced by daily luck, and the triggering of the Burglars ring will exhibit a normal distribution, with both the mean and variance related to daily luck.
除此之外，怪兽香水效果受每日运气影响，石头刷新受每日运气影响。因技术力限制，该功能目前仅针对火山口副本。
In addition, monster mask effects are affected by daily luck, and stone refreshes are affected by daily luck. Due to technological limitations, this feature is currently only available for volcano copies.
